scene: The parcel ticks softly, revealing a glowing mechanical beetle inside.
picture: Flat side-view along the level wooden floor. Far left hangs a brass horn. Left, the opened twine parcel rests on a workbench. Centre, the woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat leans forward. Right, the glowing brass beetle sits ticking on a crate. Far right stands an iron ladder leading upward.
shown: A tiny brass beetle glowing green, sitting right of the parcel.
A polished brass calling horn hanging on the wall far left.
A sturdy iron ladder fixed to the wall on the far right.
